sections.Profile:
"Truck Stop" is a 1988 pinball machine by Bally, designed after the merger with Williams and based on Bally’s prototype “Ramp Warrior.” It features a mix of parts from both companies, including Williams lower flipper mechanisms and Bally upper flipper mechanisms. The game has a unique truck driving theme with four flippers, four ramps, and a two-ball multiball mode, providing engaging gameplay.
